newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: INSTANT VIEW - Portugal's BCP boosts profit.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Portugal's BCP boosts profit.

text.p: The following our some immediate reactions to Banco Comercial Portugues' announcement that 1996 profit rose 14.8 percent to 23.27 billion escudos.
"The results are good, but these figures are not particularly new because the market was already talking of 23 billion and the (share) price discounts this number."
"But if the (share) price does react, it will be upwards. The increase in the dividend and the financial margin are pretty positive indictors."
"The share price may gain slightly but I am not expecting anything very significant. The result is in line with what was being spoken of in the market."
